title: Topic 16
japanese_text:
A：<u>念願</u>の沖縄旅行はどうだった？
B：最高だったよ！海も想像より<u>はるかに</u>きれいでさ。将来は絶対<u>移住したい</u>な〜。
A：天気にも恵まれてよかったね。
B：台風が来るかもって聞いたときはかなり<u>がっくり</u>したけどね。来なくてよかった！
english_translation: A: How was your trip to Okinawa, your dearest wish? B: It was amazing! The ocean was far more beautiful than I'd imagined. I definitely want to move there in the future! A: I'm glad you were blessed with good weather. B: I was pretty disappointed when I heard there might be a typhoon coming. I'm glad it didn't come!
